app.name: Kataquiz
app.tagline: Upload a question bank, drill it, challenge people with a link.

catalog.title: Browse quizzes
catalog.intro: Search the public catalog, or narrow it down by tag.
catalog.noMatchBody: Try fewer words, or a different tag.

quiz.author: By {name}
quiz.runSettings: {questions, plural, =1 {# question} other {# questions}}, {errors, plural, =0 {no mistakes allowed} =1 {up to # mistake} other {up to # mistakes}}, {seconds}s each
quiz.runSettingsUntimed: {questions, plural, =1 {# question} other {# questions}}, {errors, plural, =0 {no mistakes allowed} =1 {up to # mistake} other {up to # mistakes}}, no time limit

run.title: Ready to drill
run.nicknameHint: Optional, and only used on challenges you share.
run.startErrorTitle: The run could not be started

startErrors.notFound: That quiz is no longer available.
startErrors.empty: That quiz has no questions to play yet.
startErrors.rateLimited: You have started a lot of runs recently. Try again in a little while.
startErrors.unexpected: The server did not answer. Check your connection and try again.

run.chooseOne: Pick an answer to see whether it was right.
run.chooseAll: Pick every correct answer, then confirm.
run.feedbackTimedOutBody: The clock ran out, so this one counts as wrong. Take your time reading on.
run.submitErrorTitle: Your answer did not reach the server

submitErrors.duplicate: This question was already answered, so the run cannot be resumed here.
submitErrors.notYours: This run belongs to someone else. Start one of your own.
submitErrors.notFound: This run is no longer available.

run.shareBody: They play the same questions in the same order, and see your score only once they finish.
run.copyFailed: Copying failed. Select the link above and copy it by hand.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in to upload a quiz. Browsing and running quizzes needs no account.
signIn.errorBody: The provider did not answer. Check your connection and try again.
signIn.noProvidersBody: This instance has no OAuth credentials. Set GITHUB_CLIENT_ID and GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET, or the GOOGLE_ pair, then restart the server. See .env.example.

upload.title: Upload a quiz
upload.intro: Upload a YAML or JSON question bank, or paste one below.
upload.textPlaceholder: Paste your YAML or JSON quiz here

errors.unauthorized: You must be signed in to upload a quiz.
errors.tooLarge: The file is larger than 1 MB.
errors.empty: Choose a file or paste a quiz first.
errors.rateLimited: You have uploaded a lot of quizzes recently. Try again later.
